notes.title: Volley Pals has been released!
notes.notes: Volley Pals has been released. We hope you enjoy the game, especially with your friends!

notes.title: Update: Japanese translation added, and a few minor improvements
notes.notes:
- Japanese translation added
- Custom court ceiling color changed
- Gamepad infinite vibration fixed

notes.title: Black screen hotfix
notes.notes: Some players reporting encountering with a black screen at the beginning of the game tried to be solved. We are not sure if this patch will solve all the black screen cases, but it aims to be a fast start.

notes.title: Early Access and the release
notes.notes: Volley Pals has a very few revisions before making to the release version. Please play it with your real friends if you can (more fun than bots for sure), and write your feedbacks here if you have some.

notes.title: Volley Pals Demo is coming today!
notes.notes:
Volley Pals demo that features laboratory level for 1v1 is going to be released today. 

The exact date is [b]November 4th 11PM by UTC[/b].

In the demo you will be able to play against a bot with preset rules in the laboratory level which has portals.

Feel free to write us, we would love to hear back from you to improve the game further.

notes.title: Halloween Special - Volley Pals: Haunted Mansion
notes.notes: We made this special level for Halloween. It will be released along with the base game when the game finishes around Q2-2023!

notes.title: Volley Pals coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
We are very excited to show our new game Volley Pals to you! 

It is going to be released on Q2 - 2022.
